the SharedPlans framework may be reformulated in such a way that: SharedPlans may be represented in a more compact form, using the SharedPlan Tree notation; the SharedPlans meta predicate definitions may be simplified, reorganized, and reformulated using first order logic; and the conditions under which the SharedPlans theorems may be proven may be stated in a more compact, more easily understood form.
